title: Juicy Mexican Runner Beans Stir-fry
description: A fresh and cozy mexican dish featuring runner beans that are lightly seasoned with spices for a delightful flavor combo, perfect as a side dish or light meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add finely chopped onion and garlic to the pan, cook for about 2 minutes until fragrant and translucent.
Toss in jalapeno peppers, stir-fry for another minute or so until they soften slightly but still crisp.
Increase heat to high, add runner beans to the pan. Cook for about 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender yet crunchy.
Season with salt, ground cumin, and a pinch of cayenne pepper; mix well until all ingredients are coated evenly.
Serve hot as a side dish or adjust seasoning to taste before serving.
